facts.description: An experimental d3.js music visualizer from 2014. Continued as vizz.fm

research.name: Party Mode
research.note: A 2014 browser music visualizer that draws SVG sunbursts, hexbins and a wireframe icosahedron with d3.js from Web Audio data.
research.license: CC BY-NC 3.0 (Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported, stated in README; no LICENSE file)

effects: audio-driven SVG sunburst of radial wedges drawn with d3.js
wireframe icosahedron rendered in SVG with translucent faces
hexbin and voronoi visualizer modes fed by Web Audio frequency data
concentric ring pulse behind the PARTYMODE wordmark

unverified: The visualizer was not run live; only single frames of the README GIFs were viewed, so the motion and its reaction to audio are taken from the README text and not observed.
The voronoi mode is named in the README but was not seen in the frames viewed.
